news.title: China's electric truck boom lifts demand for lithium
news.summary: SINGAPORE, Nov 23 (Reuters) - Surging electric truck sales in China resulting from higher oil prices are driving demand for lithium, an unexpected bright spot for the battery metal that has ‌been dragged down by market worries of oversupply. Electric truck sales in China, the biggest market for EVs ‌and the dominant producer of batteries powering them, hit 600,000 in the first 10 months of the year, up 45%, accounting for 30% of ​sales across truck sizes, according to BofA Global Research.
